title: Phases
description: content/battles/<id>/phases.json: the battle, step by step. PLAN.md section 8.7, extended to cover everything the Cowpens prototype does. Each phase lists only what changes; unit positions and statuses carry forward from the phase before. Every phase must cite sourceIds, because positions are approximate reconstructions.

index.description: 0, 1, 2… in order. Deep links use it: #battle/cowpens/phase-4.

time.description: Clock label as shown, e.g. "07:30" or "Night".

clockTime.description: Optional machine time, e.g. 1781-01-17T07:30, for the replay scrubber (Phase 4g).

narration.description: Shown on the display. Decisions and movement, no graphic detail.

units.description: Changes this phase, keyed by unit id. Leave a unit out to keep it where it was.

movements.description: Movement arrows drawn this phase (solid, in side color).

planArrows.description: Dashed brass arrows for an intended move, e.g. the planned militia withdrawal.

fireLines.description: Dotted lines showing who's firing at whom.

hiddenFrom.description: Fog of war: for each side id, the units that side couldn't see this phase. Example: { "british": ["us-washington-cavalry"] } for Tarleton's view. (Replaces PLAN.md's knownToBritish list, which would have to repeat every visible unit each phase.)

sourceNote.description: Where in the source, e.g. "Staff ride guide, map 11: British attack and militia withdrawal, 0730."

needsVerification.description: true when a position or time in this phase couldn't be checked against the source.

estimatedPositions.description: Units whose position this phase was estimated rather than read off a source map. Listed in the phase summary.

status.description: gone = off the map (not yet arrived, or left). On the sand table: disordered = turned at an angle, surrendered = laid on its side.

facing.description: Degrees clockwise from map-up. Optional; used by game mode (Phase 4e).

decisionPoint.description: Pause and ask. Patrols commit to a choice before the leader reveals what happened.

teaser.description: Narration to show before the reveal, when the full narration would give the answer away.

holdMapUntilReveal.description: true: the map stays on the previous phase until the leader reveals the outcome.
